changes.comment: BREAKING (implementers only): memory tool result items (IMemoryToolResultItem) now carry their address, id + scope, and IMemoryWriteResult carries scope beside its id; handle is the display key only, and the tool descriptions tell the model to copy id and scope from a result into a link target or context seed. The tool layer owns id and scope: the projectItem hook now returns IMemoryToolItemProjection (the item without them), so a projector annotated as returning IMemoryToolResultItem must switch to the new type
